original_test_intent: Exercise the approved DCGM GPU-memory diagnostic and prove every GPU memory path passes without data-integrity, ECC, XID, retirement or device-health regression.
original_method: Identify GPUs and memory capacity/usage; capture ECC, XID, retired/pending pages and remap state; pin script/DCGM/driver; resolve source level 4 versus memory group level 3 and exact allocation/overwrite behavior; stop workloads, preserve logs, run once under monitoring, compare all health state and recover service/device availability.
manual_activity: GPU reliability owner selects the diagnostic level and memory region/destructive policy, approves ECC/XID thresholds and recovery; operator drains workloads and maintains OOB monitoring.
required_inputs: Dedicated window, OOB, thermal/power monitoring and recovery
safety_requirements: Do not run against active or unapproved memory contexts
Do not assume level 3 equals source level 4
Preserve complete output and error counters
No automatic retry after a memory fault
agent_execution_scope: Validate scope, memory impact, baseline and approval
Confirm workloads are drained and recovery is ready
Compare per-GPU subtests and health deltas
Restore services/state and report without verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Level 3 may target GPU memory but conflicts with the source level-4 method and lacks memory-impact, baseline and safe-access controls.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run exactly one approved pinned level/script only after workloads are drained and per-GPU memory/error baselines plus recovery are verified.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: GPU-memory diagnostic intent, 120-minute allocation and every-subtest PASS are retained; level remains an explicit decision.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Treat the run as a potentially destructive memory test with explicit region policy, per-GPU error baseline/deltas and device recovery gates.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds scope choice, memory-use safety, script identity, full health oracle and critical recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A generic broader suite cannot be presumed equivalent to the named memory group, nor can a narrower level silently replace source level 4.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: The diagnostic may allocate/overwrite GPU memory, disrupt contexts, expose latent faults or leave a GPU degraded.

project_override_considerations: Reliability engineering must define acceptable ECC/retirement deltas and whether any new correctable error, page retirement or remap event is automatic failure or quarantine.
expected_evidence: Per-GPU identity/capacity/usage and drained workload proof
Driver/DCGM versions, chosen-level rationale and script hash
Complete memory diagnostic output, exits and per-subtest results
Recovered enumeration/runtime state and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source specifies level 4 with persistence/service setup, while DeepSeek substitutes level 3 without that setup; source service ordering is also after diagnostic.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Static review is complete; execution blocks if authoritative scope, memory impact, workload drain, error oracle, pinned script or critical recovery cannot be established.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row362 Wistron-NV GPU-00355-V003: choose source level-4 or DeepSeek GPU-memory level-3 scope and setup; approve pinned memory-test script, allocation/overwrite and workload-drain policy, per-GPU ECC/XID/retirement/remap thresholds, 120-minute monitoring/abort and device recovery while preserving evidence.

review_improvement: Makes the memory test's destructive boundary and persistent error-state oracle explicit instead of silently swapping diagnostic levels.
independent_technical_reasoning: Memory diagnostics can report a test completion while leaving a new ECC, retired-page or XID condition that changes device reliability. Acceptance therefore requires per-GPU before/after integrity state, proof that no live allocation was at risk, and an intentional choice of diagnostic scope before execution.
